statement: Nvidia guided fiscal 2028 to 70% total revenue growth even though CFO Colette Kress said customer forecasts implied roughly 140% growth, because memory supply could not support the full demand implied by those forecasts.
why: The gap between customer-implied growth and the guided number puts a figure on how much revenue is being left on the table by component scarcity rather than weak demand.

impact.mechanism: Guidance still rises sharply, but the shortfall against customer forecasts shows shipments are capped by memory availability rather than by order intake.

evidence.excerpt: 70% total revenue growth ... fueled by ongoing Blackwell shipments, scaling Vera Rubin as it reaches full production,

confidence.basis: Secondary account of statements made on the August 26 earnings call; the call transcript is not this document.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: Investing.com, The Motley Fool
